title: Italy Aerial Orthophoto
description: A STAC description of the Italian national aerial orthophoto mosaic that MindEarth publishes on Source Cooperative as a cloud-native Zarr v3 array. The imagery is AGEA's national orthophoto programme, flights 2022 to 2024, merged into one seamless country-wide grid in EPSG:3857 at roughly 0.6 m per pixel with twelve pyramid levels. This catalog is a third-party mirror: it holds metadata only and points at MindEarth's published bytes, which it does not copy or re-host. Start with the [catalog agent guide](AGENTS.md) for how to read the array, and see the [collection](agea-orthophoto/collection.json) for the full provenance, licence and access notes.
